string-array.name: import_andotp_steps
string-array.item: Open the menu and tap Backup.
Tap Backup under Plain-text or, to protect the file with a password, under Password, and save it.
Choose the saved .json or .json.aes file here. A protected backup opens with the password you set.

resources.string: Tags come across with the accounts. A CometOTP backup reads the same way.
